name: Baikal GCN Reproduction
architecture: 3 GCN layers (128 units), GELU
description: Reproduction of the initial GCN model on Baikal data.

name: GCN k=2 (No LayerNorm)
architecture: 3 GCN layers (128 units), GELU, No LayerNorm
description: First successful GCN training after removing LayerNorm layers. Temporal window k=2.

name: GCN k=4 (No LayerNorm)
architecture: 3 GCN layers (128 units), GELU, No LayerNorm
description: Test with a wider temporal window k=4.

name: Capacity Expanded GCN
architecture: 3 GCN layers (512 units), GELU
description: Increased model capacity to 512 hidden units.

name: Deep & Wide GCN v3
architecture: 4 GCN layers (512-768-512 units), GELU
description: Deeper architecture with varying hidden layer widths.

name: Extended 9-Feature GCN
architecture: 4 GCN layers (512-768-512 units), GELU
description: First experiment with extended features including t_res, R, Phi, and Degree.

name: T_res Only Extended GCN
architecture: 4 GCN layers (512-768-512 units), GELU
description: Isolating the effect of the t_res feature.

name: 13-Feature GCN
architecture: 4 GCN layers (512-768-512 units), GELU
description: Extended 13-feature set including ToF residuals and neighborhood charge.

name: Causal Graph GCN
architecture: 4 GCN layers (512-768-512 units), GELU, Causal Topology
description: Experiment with causal graph topology instead of k-neighbors.

name: 1D-CNN Baseline
architecture: 1D CNN (128-256-128 channels), GELU
description: Baseline 1D convolution model on hit sequences.

name: MLP Baseline (13 features)
architecture: MLP (512-768-512 units), GELU
description: Baseline MLP model using 13 features including t_res.

name: GCN 5-Layer k=2
architecture: 5 GCN layers (128-512-512-512-128 units), GELU
description: Back to basics GCN with 5 layers and k=2.

name: Optimized JK-ResGCN (13 features)
architecture: 5 GCN layers with Jumping Knowledge and Residuals, GELU
description: Optimized GCN with 13 features and complex architecture, 1500 epochs.

name: Best JK-ResGCN (21 features)
architecture: 5 GCN layers with Jumping Knowledge and Residuals, GELU
description: The best performing GCN model with 21 features and extensive training.

name: GATv2 Marathon
architecture: 4 GATv2 layers (4 heads, 128 channels each), JK + Res
description: Long-running GATv2 experiment with dynamic attention.

name: Deep GATv2 (6 Layers)
architecture: 6 GATv2 layers (4 heads, 64 channels each), JK + Res
description: Comparison experiment focusing on depth.

name: Wide GATv2 (3 Layers)
architecture: 3 GATv2 layers (8 heads, 128 channels each), JK + Res
description: Comparison experiment focusing on width.

name: GATv2 Res Baseline
architecture: 4 GATv2 layers (4 heads, 64 channels each), Residuals, No JK
description: Study on the impact of Residual connections in GAT.

name: GATv2 No-Res Baseline
architecture: 4 GATv2 layers (4 heads, 64 channels each), No Residuals, No JK
description: Study on the impact of Residual connections in GAT (control group).

name: GATv1 vs GATv2 Study (v1)
architecture: 4 GATv1 layers (4 heads, 64 channels each), Residuals, No JK
description: Mechanism study: testing GATv1 attention.

name: GATv1 vs GATv2 Study (v2)
architecture: 4 GATv2 layers (4 heads, 64 channels each), Residuals, No JK
description: Mechanism study: testing GATv2 attention.

name: Full MLP (JK-ResGCN 1000ep)
architecture: 5 GCN layers with Jumping Knowledge and Residuals, GELU
description: Base model for optimized training marathon, uses 13 features.

name: Learnable C_Water GCN
architecture: 5 GCN layers with JK and Residuals, Learnable Parameter for C_Water
description: Used to discover the optimal effective speed of light in water (0.2264 m/ns).

name: Wide Last Layer GATv2
architecture: 4 GATv2 layers (Layer 4: 1536 channels), Residuals, No JK
description: Testing if a wide last layer can substitute for JK.

name: Fully Connected Last Layer GATv2
architecture: 4 GATv2 layers. Layer 4 uses a complete graph (all-to-all). Residuals, No JK
description: Experiment using global attention mechanism in the final layer to aggregate event-wide information.

name: GATv2 k=4 On-The-Fly
architecture: 4 GATv2 layers, Residuals, No JK. Graph built on-the-fly with k=4.
description: Testing the impact of increased graph density (k=4 vs k=2) on standard GATv2 performance.

name: Fully Connected Second Layer GATv2
architecture: 4 GATv2 layers. Layer 2 uses a complete graph (all-to-all). Residuals, No JK
description: Experiment using global attention mechanism in the second layer to aggregate event-wide information early.

name: Fully Connected Second Layer + JK
architecture: 4 GATv2 layers. Layer 2 complete graph. Jumping Knowledge concat (Layer 2 + Layer 4).
description: Combines global attention in the second layer with JK to bypass oversmoothing in subsequent local layers.

name: Fully Connected Last Layer (k=4)
architecture: 4 GATv2 layers. Layer 4 uses complete graph. Local graphs built on-the-fly with k=4.
description: Replicating the best performing architecture (FC on last layer) but increasing local graph density to k=4.

name: Dynamic Edge Rewiring (k=2)
architecture: 4 GATv2 layers. Dynamic rewiring before the last layer using Q @ K^T. Alpha=0.1.
description: Uses metric learning via Q and K projections to dynamically delete worst edges and add best edges in the event.

name: Dynamic Input Edge Rewiring
architecture: 4 GATv2 layers. Input graph rewired dynamically on raw features (from epoch 2). Layer 4 complete graph.
description: Tests metric learning on raw features to dynamically restructure local neighborhood graphs while keeping the final layer fully connected.

name: Differentiable Rewiring: Edge Weights
architecture: 4 GATv2 layers. Input graph rewired dynamically. edge_weight = sigmoid(S).
description: Experiment 1: Gradient flows through edge_attr using sigmoid of Q@K^T similarity.

name: Differentiable Rewiring: STE
architecture: 4 GATv2 layers. Input graph rewired dynamically. Straight-Through Estimator.
description: Experiment 2: Forward pass uses hard edges (1.0). Backward pass flows through soft similarity.

name: Differentiable Rewiring: Gumbel-Softmax
architecture: 4 GATv2 layers. Input graph rewired dynamically with Gumbel noise and temperature annealing.
description: Experiment 3: Stochastic rewiring with Gumbel noise. Temperature decays from 5.0 to 0.1.

name: Custom GATv2: Edge Weights
architecture: 4 Custom GATv2 layers (first 3). e_ij = a^T LeakyReLU(W[hi||hj]) + W_ij. W_ij = S_ij.
description: Experiment 1: Custom GATv2Conv with direct scalar addition to attention logits. Uses raw Q@K^T similarity.

name: Custom GATv2: STE
architecture: 4 Custom GATv2 layers (first 3). e_ij = a^T LeakyReLU(W[hi||hj]) + W_ij. W_ij = (0-soft)+soft.
description: Experiment 2: Forward pass W_ij = 0 (standard GAT). Backward pass gradients flow through soft similarity.

name: Custom GATv2: Gumbel-Softmax
architecture: 4 Custom GATv2 layers (first 3). e_ij = a^T LeakyReLU(W[hi||hj]) + W_ij. W_ij = S_noisy / tau.
description: Experiment 3: Stochastic rewiring with Gumbel noise. W_ij directly scales attention logits. Temperature decays 5.0 -> 0.1.

name: GATv2 Auxiliary Task Rewiring
architecture: 4 GATv2 layers. Input features used for Q and K projections. Hard top-k rewiring. Auxiliary BCE Loss on S=QK^T.
description: Explicitly trains Q and K to cluster signal hits. Target for S_ij is y_i * y_j. lambda=1.0.

name: GATv2 Auxiliary Task V2 (Similarity)
architecture: 4 GATv2 layers. Input features used for Q and K projections. Hard top-k rewiring. Auxiliary BCE Loss on S=QK^T.
description: Explicitly trains Q and K to cluster signal-signal and noise-noise. Target for S_ij is 1 if y_i==y_j else 0. lambda=1.0.

name: GATv2 FC-Last-Layer + k=8
architecture: 4 GATv2 layers. Last layer is a fully connected graph. Initial graph k=8 on the fly.
description: Scaling up k-NN graph from k=4 to k=8.

name: GATv2 FC-Last-Layer + k=12
architecture: 4 GATv2 layers. Last layer is a fully connected graph. Initial graph k=12 on the fly.
description: Scaling up k-NN graph from k=4 to k=12.

name: GATv2 FC-Last-Layer + k=16
architecture: 4 GATv2 layers. Last layer is a fully connected graph. Initial graph k=16 on the fly.
description: Scaling up k-NN graph from k=12 to k=16.

name: GATv2 CosSim beta=0.7
architecture: 4 GATv2 layers. Base k=1 KNN. Layers 2 & 3 dynamically add edges based on cosine similarity > 0.7 of hidden states. Layer 4 fully connected.
description: Dynamic graph rewiring using explicit cosine similarity. Replaces previous learnable attention edges.
